title: Step Left to wave of Four
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 4 "robins start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends pass partner right to start" isn't drawn yet.

Row 1 "neighbors balance & swing swing to wave of four, both neighbors release hand hold , and take short step to there left , the robins will going to center to take left hands with same gender from the other side of set , the step left at the same time the robins did , he step left a small step to take right hand of his swing partner he is on the out side of the wave of 4 so both are going in the opposite direction at the same time(SWING PARTNERS MUST END SWING WHERE THEY STARTED SWING! · ocean-wave" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 2 "balance wave of four" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
The progression after row 7 "circle left 3 places and pass thru to new neighbor · pass through" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
